pivot.supersedes: 0.1.0 — runtime assurance / unknown side-effect adjudication as product thesis
pivot.reason: That thesis is already addressed by verified tool-call and postcondition work, postcondition MCP implementations, exactly-once middleware, runtime execution-proof work, and current agent-control standards.
pivot.new_center: interaction-aware, stateful reliability experimentation and failure reduction
pivot.note: The demoted mechanisms are also FACTORS in the experiment space, which is strictly more useful than being the product.

core_problem: Given a tool-using agent, its environment model, tool contracts, and explicit reliability/safety invariants, systematically explore combinations of runtime faults, tool behavior, context/state mutations, policy/configuration changes, and model behavior; identify invariant violations; minimize the failing configuration/trace; and compile the result into a reproducible regression test.
production_claim: none. Prototype and reference implementation. All results are obtained against a synthetic environment and a factor model this project authored. claim_scope is never PRODUCTION_BEHAVIOR.
note_on_completion: No artifact is COMPLETE. REWRITTEN means written and internally consistent. No feature is implemented. No code exists.

mandatory_corrections_applied.correction: OQ-01 reframed: CP1..CP8 semantic capability taxonomy; capability profile is a varied CONFIG factor, not a blocker. Real-API survey demoted to adapter-prioritization study and external-validity limitation.
Idempotency fixed: effect_id / request_digest / schema_version are three separate fields. schema_version NEVER enters effect_id. Semantic change without a declared new step fails closed.

Evidence fixed: five orthogonal fields (claim_type, observation_source, provenance, assurance_level, derivation_method) plus claim_scope. Deterministic derivation over an untrusted payload is a claim about what the source reported, not a world fact.

Causal language fixed: 'randomized intervention' removed; CONTROLLED_INTERVENTION_RESULT used. A version change is STATISTICAL_ASSOCIATION, not a natural experiment. Banned: root cause, caused by, due to, because of, natural experiment, randomized.
90/7/3 split removed. Three evidence layers L-DET / L-LOC / L-REM, never pooled into one statistic.
Retry safety by semantic effect class: PURE_READ, IDEMPOTENT_READ, IDEMPOTENT_WRITE, NON_IDEMPOTENT_WRITE, UNKNOWN. HTTP verb and read_only removed as criteria.
Central claim narrowed: never exactly-once against arbitrary external systems. Unsupported systems yield INDETERMINATE / UNVERIFIABLE. claim_scope=PRODUCTION_BEHAVIOR is unconstructible.
Source lint demoted to secondary. Primary control is typed capability isolation: illegal evidence production is impossible by construction.
Replay modes made precise: EXACT_REPLAY / CONTROLLED_REPLAY / LIVE_EXECUTION. LIVE_EXECUTION is never called replay. Divergence invalidates counterfactual interpretation unless explicitly handled.

LLM demoted to optional narration / system under test. Never required for fault scheduling, experiment arithmetic, authorization, state transitions, oracle evaluation, anomaly math, hypothesis ranking, replay integrity, scoring, evidence bookkeeping, or failure reduction.

invariants.statement: No duplicate side effect: each effect_id appears at most once in the ground-truth effect log
No unauthorized action: every applied effect has a matching authorization decision with sufficient scope
Postcondition consistency against the authoritative source
Bounded retries per effect_id and per execution
No unsafe tool sequence per the declared sequence policy
Task completion: the declared goal postcondition holds
No unknown-outcome promotion: INDETERMINATE is never recorded as APPLIED or NOT_APPLIED
Determinism: identical (fixture_digest, seed, assignment, versions) implies identical trace_digest. Evaluated as an ORACLE, not assumed.

build_gates.name: Environment, Ledger, Adapter
build_gates.objective: A trial can be executed, observed, and byte-reproduced.
scope: versioned fixture store with snapshot/restore BY DIGEST
five synthetic services with declarable CP1..CP8 profiles
ground-truth effect log unreachable from ZONE S
exit_tests: 1000 trials run twice yield identical trace_digest for every pair
fixture restore digest equals declared baseline
agent credential DENIED on the ground-truth log
narrator with no capability cannot construct ObservedEvent
full suite passes with zero LLM availability
build_gates.not_premature_because: Every downstream capability (reduction, fingerprinting, regression artifacts) is invalid without byte-reproducibility. Snapshot-restore-by-digest cannot be retrofitted; adding it later rewrites every component that touched state.

build_gates.name: Oracles, Fault Injector, Runner
build_gates.objective: A single trial under a named factor assignment yields a versioned oracle verdict.
scope: retry legality by semantic effect class
invariants: every oracle returns INDETERMINATE rather than defaulting to HOLDS
exit_tests: oracle meta-suite: known-pass, known-fail, adversarial near-miss, degenerate, mutation
an oracle that crashes or defaults to HOLDS on degenerate input FAILS THE BUILD
serialization change yields same effect_id
semantic change without declared new step yields ABORTED/EFFECT_IDENTITY_VIOLATION
replica-lag fault yields INDETERMINATE never NOT_APPLIED
server-side request count equals adapter attempt_no
build_gates.not_premature_because: A planner without trustworthy oracles generates volume, not signal. An oracle that silently never fires is indistinguishable from a reliable system; this gate makes that impossible before any large run.

build_gates.name: Experiment Planner and Coverage
build_gates.objective: A bounded, constraint-aware plan over the factor space with honest coverage accounting.
scope: coverage report C9 including the unexplored space
invariants: coverage report states infeasible_fraction and constraints_applied
screening and adaptive trials reported separately
exit_tests: independent verifier confirms every feasible pair is covered
S2: engine finds >=1 two-factor interaction failure whose single-factor arms both pass at n>=50
OQ-08 seeded-bug detection rate measured against externally-authored bugs
build_gates.not_premature_because: Screening is minutes and reduction is hours. Planning before reduction means failures arrive faster than they can be processed, which is the correct order: the reducer's budget must be sized from real failure volume.
deferred: t=3 until a 3-way failure is found that pairwise missed

build_gates.name: Failure Reduction and Fingerprinting
build_gates.objective: A failure reduces to a stable, minimal-with-confidence reproducer.
scope: fingerprint composition and clustering with stability metric
invariants: a reduction is accepted only if the fingerprint is unchanged
exit_tests: S3: seeded non-monotone fixture yields REDUCTION_UNSTABLE not a confident minimum
seeded fingerprint-collision fixture flags the cluster UNSTABLE
reduction of a known 3-factor interaction recovers exactly those three in >= x% of independent runs, x measured not asserted
build_gates.not_premature_because: Reduction is the cost centre (13-27h for 50 failures vs 8min screening). Building it before the planner produces real failure volume would size its budget from imagination.
deferred: automated root-cause attribution (does not exist, will not be built)

build_gates.name: Interaction Estimation and Regression Compilation
build_gates.objective: A minimized failure becomes an interaction estimate with an interval and a re-executable regression artifact.
scope: BH-FDR over the pre-declared hypothesis family
McNemar only where pairing genuinely holds
invariants: interaction estimates derive ONLY from Phase-3 data (enforced by InterventionCapability)
every estimate carries raw p, adjusted p, q, family size and family identity
every artifact carries a measured reproduction_rate with an interval
exit_tests: S4: artifact re-executes from the artifact alone on a clean checkout and reproduces within its recorded interval
null-factor control does not survive FDR across >= 20 independent screens
a 0.4-reproduction artifact is executed r times against a threshold, never once
build_gates.not_premature_because: Estimation requires minimized factor sets. Running factorials over 14 factors is 7 million cells; reduction is what makes estimation affordable.

build_gates.name: Model Canary Boundary and Reporting
build_gates.objective: The model becomes a system under test on a fixed budgeted canary boundary, and the run is reportable with its limits.
scope: L-LOC and L-REM canary suites, separately reported
provider adapter with token-metered local budget and header reconciliation
MCP adapter behind the internal tool protocol
export of coverage plus limitations plus artifacts
invariants: no remote call required by any deterministic component
exit_tests: S5: full pipeline with provider egress blocked produces byte-identical structured output
canary budget enforced by a counter; exceeding it aborts with a partial report
report contains the unexplored space and the external-validity limitation verbatim
build_gates.not_premature_because: The model is the most expensive and least reproducible factor. Bringing it in last means a canary discrepancy localises to the model rather than to the harness.

kill_conditions.reason: A deterministic-simulation vendor ships an agent adapter with a tool-capability factor model. Their determinism story is stronger because they control the scheduler.
The deterministic substrate means we are mostly testing our own harness, not agents. Affordability and relevance are in direct opposition and the pivot does not resolve it.
Concurrency and shared state, the most valuable interaction class, may require a deterministic scheduler. Without it they are untestable; with it this becomes a simulator build.
Nobody's job is 'agent failure lab'. No budget line, no on-call rotation, no workflow to slot into. Most likely actual cause of death and not a technical objection.
The factor model is our own hypothesis, so the discovery claim is circular. A tool that only finds failures its authors imagined is an elaborate checklist.

research_validity_challenge.thesis_under_test: Failures in tool-using AI agents emerge from interactions between agent decisions, execution history, environment state, tool semantics, context state, authorization state and runtime conditions; a useful system discovers, characterizes, reduces and regression-tests them.
research_validity_challenge.falsifiable_form: T*: there exists a class F of failures such that each requires >=2 simultaneously-active conditions from distinct layers; is not found by single-factor sweeps at equal budget; is NOT found by uniform random sampling plus interaction regression at equal budget; is characterizable with decoys excluded; and is non-empty for agents we did not write under dimensions we did not choose.

settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.finding: Uniform random sampling covers 95.4% of two-way level combinations at the SAME budget as the designed pairwise array (45 configs). Reaching 99% costs 77 random configs vs ~45 designed: efficiency 1.7x. At t=3, random reaches 99% in ~289 configs vs an assumed ~350 designed: NO advantage.
settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.consequence: 'Covering-array testing for agents' is not a thesis. It is a 1.7x constant-factor optimization over a free baseline. T*(c) is NOT satisfied by the screening design.

settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.finding: Under uniform random assignment a decoy is independent of the true cause, so random sampling plus logistic interaction regression rejects decoys without any designed experiment.
settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.consequence: The design is an optimization; the analysis is standard DOE. Deleting the covering array loses 1.7x efficiency and retains 100% of the epistemic value.

settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.finding: r_confirm=5 produces at least one over-inclusion with probability 0.99 at p=0.4 and 1.00 at p=0.2 across ~54 ddmin decisions. Required r is 14 at p=0.4 and 32 at p=0.2.
settled_by_arithmetic_before_any_experim.consequence: Gate 0.5's r_confirm=5 is wrong as a standalone parameter. It is defensible ONLY because the confirmatory subset sweep follows it (r=5 + sweep = 990 trials vs r=12 + sweep = 1008). Reduction differentiation rests entirely on interaction-aware reduction (M4).

gate_0_75_recommendation.basis: F1 and F2 (arithmetic, no experiment needed) plus the pre-registered benchmark prediction table, which predicts a tie against the A2 null on 5 of 9 failure classes and a clear win on 2 -- both of which are adequacy, not detection.
gate_0_75_recommendation.pivot_target: model-adequacy instrument: adjudicate whether a declared factor model explains an observed failure, reject decoys, and refuse to attribute when the mechanism is unobservable.
gate_0_75_recommendation.rework_cost: LOW. Same factor model, same oracles, same Phase-3 design, same substrate. What changes is the headline claim, what the benchmark measures, and the demotion of covering arrays from thesis to default.
gate_0_75_recommendation.highest_information_experiment: Benchmark cases B-19 and B-20 (ABSENT_UNRECORDED, with and without a correlated decoy), 10 replications each, scored against arm A2 at equal trial budget.
gate_0_75_recommendation.explicit_kill_criterion: CMR > 0.20 on B-19/B-20 -- the system attributes an unobservable mechanism to a declared factor in more than 1 in 5 cases. Unconditional, no override.

gate_0_9.epistemic_flaw_corrected: Gate 0.75 case B-20 required UNKNOWN_MODEL for an unobserved mechanism with a visible decoy correlated at 0.7. Those two causal structures are OBSERVATIONALLY EQUIVALENT: no estimator separates them. The benchmark demanded an unearnable verdict and scored the method's CORRECT behaviour (naming the decoy as a candidate) as catastrophic, then made it the hard kill criterion. We shipped an invalid evaluation into our own kill gate and it survived three adversarial passes.
gate_0_9.fix: Controlled falsification. Intervene on the decoy; if the failure persists the decoy is falsified as sufficient. INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVABILITY is reachable ONLY after every observable candidate has been falsified by intervention. If intervention is unavailable or non-surgical the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE, which is a different and weaker claim.
gate_0_9.thesis_under_test: T**: there exists a class D of evaluation-integrity defects such that (a) each causes the eval to measure something other than the intended capability; (b) each is detectable by a specifiable deterministic test, statistical test or controlled intervention; (c) A NAIVE COMPOSITION OF EXISTING SINGLE-PURPOSE TOOLS MISSES A MATERIALLY LARGE SHARE OF D; (d) non-identifiable candidates are falsified by intervention or returned as INCONCLUSIVE; (e) D occurs in evaluations we did not author. (c) IS THE WHOLE THESIS -- a,b,d,e are all satisfiable by the baseline.

verdict_vocabulary.SUPPORTED_WITHIN_TESTED_SPACE: explanation survived controlled intervention, within tested levels/observables/power. Requires the intervention record.
verdict_vocabulary.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: survived intervention but a residual above the floor remains; nested verdict on the remainder.
verdict_vocabulary.MODEL_GAP_DETECTED: an observable outside the declared factor model associates with the residual. OBSERVATIONAL_ASSOCIATION only; no intervention claimed.
verdict_vocabulary.INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVABILITY: EVERY observable candidate falsified by intervention, effect survives, observability inventory complete, zero untested candidates.
verdict_vocabulary.INCONCLUSIVE: the discriminating experiment was not performed. Reason from a closed enum: NOT_SETTABLE | NON_SURGICAL | UNDERPOWERED | BUDGET_EXHAUSTED | UNSAFE. THE DEFAULT VERDICT.
verdict_vocabulary.INVALID_EVALUATION: an integrity defect makes the result untrustworthy regardless of agent behaviour. DOMINATES: affected results are WITHHELD, not caveated.
removed: UNKNOWN_MODEL (conflated 'experiments came back negative' with 'we did not run them')

statistical_audit_results.method: 1500 simulations, m=126, q=alpha=0.05, FDR = mean per-simulation V/R
statistical_audit_results.BH: controls FDR at 0.036-0.061 under ALL five structures. Power 0.35 at z=3, 0.75 at z=4. RETAINED as default.
statistical_audit_results.BY: FDR 0.007-0.017 (4-6x conservative), power roughly HALVED (0.19 vs 0.35 at z=3). NO evidence for adopting it.
statistical_audit_results.WY_maxT_permutation: controls FWER at ~0.055 everywhere; power between BY and BH EXCEPT under near-duplicate tests where it BEATS BH (0.49 vs 0.40 at z=3). Adopted for the aliased/duplicate sub-family only.
statistical_audit_results.power_floor_OQ22_resolved: z~4 needed for power 0.75. delta=0.10 costs ~1340 trials per cell (45 min). Below delta~0.08 nothing is affordably detectable at any n.
statistical_audit_results.family_shrinking: Screening on VARIANCE ONLY (which dimensions actually varied), recorded with its digest BEFORE any association is computed, cuts the family from 126 to ~36 -- a 3.5x power gain worth more than any choice among the three methods.

gate_0_95.thesis: An agent evaluation can produce a plausible score while being invalid because of interactions among environment, oracle, agent behavior, state, contamination, stochasticity and evaluation design. A useful assurance system should detect these cross-dimension validity defects, use controlled intervention where attribution is possible, refuse unsupported conclusions, and produce an auditable assurance report.
gate_0_95.question: Whether integrating these mechanisms around AGENT EVALUATION VALIDITY creates measurable value beyond a competent composition.

baseline_tiers.C0: six mature tools run independently, six separate reports, no cross-referencing. Named so it can be REJECTED as the comparison. Never primary.
baseline_tiers.C1: C0 + shared trial corpus + shared identifiers + a competent engineer's unified cross-reference pass. PRIMARY COMPARISON.
baseline_tiers.C2: C1 + the falsification protocol executed BY HAND. DIAGNOSTIC: decides whether our contribution is the protocol or the engine.
baseline_tiers.why_it_matters: If BASELINE-C is defined as tools that nobody cross-references, we test 'integrated vs not integrated', win by definition, and prove nothing about whether the integration is HARD. Both tiers must run and the primary must be the harder one.

gate_0_95.the_reframe: C2 beating A-INT is NOT simply a loss. It is a finding about WHAT TO BUILD: if a careful human running the protocol matches the engine, the deliverable is a SPECIFICATION plus a CONFORMANCE SUITE that any evaluation harness runs against itself -- cheaper, more adoptable, no maintenance question, and it sidesteps the ownership problem. No earlier gate could have produced this finding.

statistical_findings.finding: THE PRIMARY TEST AS SPECIFIED CANNOT REACH SIGNIFICANCE. 6 E2 defects; our own pre-registered prediction is C1 detects 5 and A-INT detects 6 -- one discordant pair, exact McNemar p=1.0.

12 cross-dimension defects is arithmetically inadequate: significance requires EVERY discordant defect to favour A-INT (d=6,k=6 -> p=0.031). At f=0.8, p=0.219. N=24 is the minimum tolerating a realistic 80% win rate (d=12,k=10 -> p=0.039). The brief's floor of 12 is raised to 24.
Replication does not buy population power. 12 defects x 10 reps is ~13 effective observations at ICC 0.95, not 120. The DEFECT is the unit of analysis. Replications cut to 5.
BASELINE-C C1 is approximately 3 weeks for one competent engineer. That is the number a multi-month build must beat.

EVERY edge we predict is the falsification protocol, not the integration: decoy rejection (X-03/08/12/20), refusal on non-surgical cases (X-16), INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVABILITY instead of a guess (X-19), canary detection of unrecorded residue (X-06). C2 performs all of these by hand.

The recursion terminates in human review; a pass means 'the ten mistakes we already know how to make are caught', not 'the engine is sound'.

gate_1_0.correction_accepted: Gate 0.95 read C2 wrongly. 'A competent human can execute the protocol' does not imply the engine is unnecessary -- compilers did not become unnecessary because people can write assembly. The question is recurring cost at frequency, not one-shot capability.
gate_1_0.challenge_added: An automation thesis is ENTIRELY contingent on frequency. The load-bearing number is packages per year, and it is derived, not chosen: ~32/yr covers maintenance alone, ~150/yr repays the build inside 2 years. At 72/yr -- one team gating its own releases -- payback is 5.4 years. The automation thesis does NOT survive a single team.
gate_1_0.product_thesis_T1_0: For an AI platform team operating SHARED evaluation infrastructure across multiple product teams at >=150 evaluation packages/year, a reusable assurance engine (a) automatically executes the falsification protocol via a declared adapter; (b) misses NO validity defect a competent human executing the same protocol detects -- zero unfavourable discordance; (c) emits a machine-readable artifact carrying an EARNED claim_supported status a release gate can block on; (d) reduces recurring human effort from ~3.6h to <=0.5h per package; (e) repays its build within <=3 years at the user's MEASURED volume.
why_candidate_wording_rejected: 'materially reducing' is unquantified -- the same vagueness relocated to the efficiency claim
no correctness floor: an engine that is fast and wrong satisfies it
no frequency condition, so the economic claim is unfalsifiable
no named user and no artifact consumer
gate_1_0.primary_user: The engineer who owns SHARED evaluation infrastructure for an AI platform team serving multiple product teams -- the person other teams' agents pass through before release. NOT the agent author, NOT the benchmark author. Selected on frequency: the other three candidates fall below the maintenance break-even.

workflow_economics.where_the_time_is: cross-reference (45m) + falsification interventions (50m) = 44% of recurring time. Exactly the two steps no existing tool performs.

statistical_corrections.error: METRICS.md cited n=112 per arm for FAR with MDE 0.15. 112 was the n REQUIRED to achieve MDE 0.15; it was never the n AVAILABLE. A power calculation was transcribed into the design as though it were the design.
statistical_corrections.correction: Actual denominator is 24 packages x 5 clustered replications = effective n ~29 at ICC 0.8. Real MDE is 0.29-0.32, not 0.15. No observations excluded; 112 is discarded. The C-2 threshold of 0.10 was unmeasurable by ~3x and is replaced by a paired discordance criterion (A-INT's FAR must not exceed C1's on more than 2 of 24 packages).
statistical_corrections.severity: fourth self-inflicted validity defect in this project's history; third caught by re-deriving a number

statistical_corrections.error: Statistical non-inferiority at a defensible margin (delta=0.175, preserving 50% of C2's advantage over C0) requires 96 defects per arm. We have 24, whose MDE is 0.35 -- wider than any margin worth stating.
statistical_corrections.correction: Replaced by ZERO UNFAVOURABLE DISCORDANCE: A-INT misses no defect C2 detects. Measurable at n=24 and STRICTER than statistical non-inferiority -- if the two were truly equal at 30% discordance, P(zero unfavourable) ~ 0.008, so we would almost certainly fail.

statistical_corrections.error: Three of six preregistered claims were specified against an n the experiment does not have.
statistical_corrections.correction: All three replaced or flagged. The CDDR primary on 6 E2 defects remains underpowered and is not fixed by these corrections.

gate_1_0.replication_preserved: Defect remains the population unit; majority classification feeds McNemar. BUT per-replication outcomes, detection rate, Wilson interval, majority classification and INSTABILITY are retained and emitted in assurance_artifact.reproduction.replication_detail and section 7 of the human report. A system detecting a defect 3/5 times differs meaningfully from 5/5 and the majority erases it; mean instability is a reported headline metric alongside CDDR.
gate_1_0.baseline_adjudication: Advocate VETO replaced by ADVOCATE CHALLENGE with a standard of review. A challenge must cite an EXACT preregistered strength floor; one citing no floor is automatically NOT UPHELD. An independent adjudicator (neither team) rules. UPHELD triggers a RE-RUN of affected packages for both arms -- the experiment is repaired, not voided. NOT UPHELD publishes the dissent verbatim. UNRESOLVED downgrades a CONTINUE to PIVOT.

e2_authorship_plan.why_not_1x18: 18 defects from one author are one author's STYLE replicated, not 18 independent samples. 4 authors gives 3 degrees of freedom on the author effect -- enough to see a large effect, not a subtle one. Recorded as a compromise.
e2_authorship_plan.substrate: 2 of 4 authors use a DIFFERENT substrate (a public harness adapted to our package schema). This also tests the interface for real: if an outside author cannot express their defect in the schema, the SCHEMA is wrong, and that is worth more than the defect.
e2_authorship_plan.ontology: 2 of 4 are NOT shown the invariant list. Crossed 2x2 with substrate. Author 4 (blind to ontology, different substrate) produces the only defects not shaped by our assumptions twice over -- 5 defects, the most informative and least powerful numbers in the experiment.
e2_authorship_plan.common_method_bias: per-author detection rates with Wilson intervals (halfwidth +/-0.33 at n=5 -- reveals collapse only); inter-author structural similarity ratio; 2x2 substrate x ontology breakdown. A rate high on O-1 and low on O-2 IS the circularity failure, and this 2x2 is the first design that can see it.
e2_authorship_plan.do_not_commission_yet: Measure per-framework adapter cost (column F) FIRST. If adapter cost kills the economics, none of these defects will ever be scored.

competitive_2026.status: ALL external items ASSERTED_UNVERIFIED; OQ-24 blocks gate exit on reading primary sources
competitive_2026.coverage: 8 of 11 workflow steps are solved by existing work (NIST probes/audit trails, NIST cheating/contamination, AgentRx trajectory diagnosis, AgentChaos fault injection, current frameworks, mature mutation/flaky/hermeticity tooling). The 3 unsolved -- cross-referencing into a validity judgement, falsifying before attributing, emitting an earned machine-checkable unsupported status -- consume 44% of recurring human time.
competitive_2026.integration_rejected: 'Integration' is what C1 achieves with a shared corpus and a competent engineer in ~3 weeks. Rejected as insufficient.
competitive_2026.surviving_answer: An EARNED, machine-checkable status asserting an evaluation's own claim is not supported by its own evidence -- derived only after a falsification attempt, carrying the derivation as a REQUIRED schema field, emitted so a release gate can block on it. Three load-bearing properties: it is NEGATIVE (a defensible refusal, an output type nothing in the landscape produces), EARNED (anyone can emit unsupported:true; the schema requires the derivation), and GATEABLE (consumed by a gate, not filed by a human).
competitive_2026.honest_character: This is NOT a technical capability gap. It is a COST POINT. C2 produces exactly this output. What does not exist is producing it at marginal human cost ~0, repeatedly, in CI. That is a legitimate thesis -- compilers, CI, linters and fuzzing infrastructure are all 'a human could do this, at a cost' -- but legitimate ONLY at frequency, which makes OQ-25 the whole project.
competitive_2026.survey_implication: A systematic survey means the field has a name, a literature, and an enumerated open-problems list. Problem identification is no longer a contribution. The survey's open-problems section is where to check whether our claim is already named -- and reading it could close this project in an afternoon, for less cost than any other action available.

gate_1_0.automation_utility_criterion: AUC-1: A-INT satisfies it if EITHER (A) it detects strictly more E2 defects than C2 at exact McNemar p<0.05; OR (B) all four of: B1 zero unfavourable discordance vs C2; B2 recurring human minutes <= 0.25 x C2 (deliberately LENIENT -- our own estimate is 0.09x, and setting the threshold at 0.1x would be tuning to our prediction); B3 time to first correct finding <= 0.5 x C2 median; B4 net annual saving exceeds maintenance AND cumulative payback <=3 years at MEASURED volume. B2 and B3 require a HUMAN STUDY, not a simulation.

three_advantages_kept_separate.correctness: PREDICTED NONE over C2; possibly over C1
three_advantages_kept_separate.economic: UNRESOLVED -- contingent on OQ-25 (volume) and OQ-27/column F (adapter cost), either of which can make it negative

gate_1_0.column_F_threat: Per-framework adapter cost is unmeasured and interacts ADVERSELY with the user choice. The user was selected for high package volume, but volume comes from serving many product teams, and many teams means many evaluation frameworks -- each needing its own TrialSource, EffectLog and EnvironmentProbe adapter. At an assumed 24h/framework: 20 frameworks costs 480h, consuming the entire saving from 148 packages/year -- the whole reason the user was chosen. The variable supplying frequency is the variable supplying setup cost. MEASURE THIS BEFORE THE E2 COMMISSION.
